base.text: Add a random Wincon card to your hand, and its plan: a Base Camp for Reach the Summit; a Star Chart for Alteran Reach; an Infinite Reserves for A Glimpse into the Endless Sea; for Aestheticize the Game, Discover a Spa Day, a Garage Sale or a Leg Day.

radiant.text: Add a random Radiant Wincon card to your hand, and its Radiant plan: a Radiant Base Camp for Reach the Summit; a Radiant Star Chart for Alteran Reach; a Radiant Infinite Reserves for A Glimpse into the Endless Sea; for Aestheticize the Game, Discover a Radiant Spa Day, Garage Sale or Leg Day.
